mentions.name: Yarnz (West African Pidgin English dictionary)
mentions.description: A standardized dictionary and lexicon for the variant of pidgin English spoken in West Africa, containing words and phrases with their accompanying context.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A standardized dictionary/lexicon for the variant of pidgin English that is spoken around Western-Africa.

https://yarnz.app/

It contains words and phrases with their accompanying context.
